THE FULL TRAINER · EARLY ACCESS SOON

Practice that knows
where your points are.

Every answer you give tells Hatoove something. The trainer uses it to show where you stand against the pass mark—and to put the next question where it earns you the most.

  • See your points against the pass line.

    An estimate for every exam part, measured against the 60 % mark. It sharpens as you practise.

  • Weak spots first.

    Connectors, cases, word order, covering every point in your letter—practice shifts toward whatever is costing you marks right now.

  • Mistakes come back—on schedule.

    Every error returns with its explanation after 1, 3, 7, 16 and 35 days, until it sticks.

  • A plan to your exam date.

    Day by day, sized to the time you have. Tasks tick themselves off, with a full timed mock before the day.

Forecasts are estimates from your practice answers, not exam results. The trainer covers reading, language elements, listening and writing; speaking is not included yet.

GOOD QUESTIONS

A few things
worth knowing.

Clear expectations from the start.

Is Hatoove a language course?

Hatoove is focused on exam preparation. It is designed for people who already have a foundation in the language and want to understand the exam format, practise its tasks and work on the mistakes that cost marks.

Which exam can I try here?

This preview contains original, shortened practice samples for telc Deutsch B1: reading, language elements and writing. The broader product scope includes listening and written sections. The samples are not official telc questions or a full mock exam.

Can I get explanations in my language?

You can switch the practice instructions and explanations between English and German in this preview. The exercise text stays in German, as it should for a German exam. Further instruction languages are planned.

Will my writing receive an AI score?

This preview gives you a structured self-review checklist and a model response to compare with your own. It does not grade your writing or claim to predict your exam result.

Does this prepare me for the speaking exam?

Not yet. Automatic speech recognition is not reliable enough to judge spoken German fairly, so we would rather leave it out than give you misleading feedback. For telc Deutsch B1, you must pass the written and oral parts separately. Performance on these samples cannot establish whether you will pass the complete exam.

Is the preview free? Do I need an account?

The samples here are free, and no account or payment is required. Your draft stays in this page while it is open; it is not submitted for assessment or saved to an account. Reloading the page clears it. Paid packages and regional pricing are not available in this preview.
